QuestInfo.name: General Enhancement Course
QuestInfo.0: Continue the Resistance's educational program. Talk to #b#p2151010##k at the #m310010010# to begin the secret educational program.
QuestInfo.1: One must complete all three courses in order to participate in the secret course, which is a General Enhancement Course. Enter #b#m310010400##k and eliminate #o9300412#. #r#o9300412##k has the ability to fly, which helps the trainees enhance their general abilities.\n\n#o9300412##r #a231061##k
QuestInfo.2: You went back to #p2151010# to report your completion and reached Lv. 14. You wonder if you can receive your first mission now...

0.0: This challenge is only available to those who have completed all of their basic training. It is not an exclusive club, but it is one of distinction! By completing this challenge, you will prove you possess the basic traits of a Resistance operative.

yes.0: Entering #b#m310010400##k will place you face to face with #r#o9300412##k units. If you can defeat #r15#k of them, you will have completed the Educational Program, and proven yourself a capable member of the Resistance. I'm afraid it won't be easy. Why is that, you ask?
yes.1: That is because #o9300412# units are capable of flight! There is nothing trickier than striking down a target on the move! To succeed, you will need to harness all of the skills you have practiced: Agility, Strength, and Patience. Well then, go in there and do us proud!

no.0: I'm afraid I cannot authorize you for any missions until you've proven your abilities. Entrusting someone who is not ready with a mission could put our entire organization at risk. If you would like to be assigned a mission, then you must prove yourself!

1.0: So you defeated the #o9300412# units... Outstanding! It seems you may very well be Resistance material after all. Err, not that I ever doubted you...

yes.0: You've made it through our Educational Program. Very good! Just don't let it go to your head. Our enemy's strength grows every day, and they strike without hesitation. We must be vigilant in our training to keep them at bay.\r\n
yes.1: Now that you have reached Lv. 14, you are finally ready to receive your #bfirst mission#k. Good work! Go see your #bjob instructor#k for your assignment. Just remember, if I hear your performance is falling behind, we'll have to put you through training all over again!

mob.0: I never said taking down #r15 #o9300412# units#k would be easy. Actually, I explicitly said the opposite. Just remember everything you've learned so far and get it done.
